constraints: Scratch-only Windows experiments use the active Ninja compiler and ordered flags; actual-source and scratch-source controls must reproduce the entire current raw object before variants are interpreted. Unknown forms or a changed target roster or pragma/macro association fail closed.

Anonymous relocation normalization is limited to LOCAL binding-0 objects in pointer-free .sdata2 or .rodata, with valid within-object addends and equal full bytes, size, and section. Named symbols retain exact identity; mutable or externally visible data is not interchangeable by value.

The --verify-retained mode requires the archived experiment directory containing report.json, baseline raw/processed objects, target object, and original compiler/edge identity. Preserve the archive before worktree cleanup; the tool is not a self-contained historical proof without it.

PASS describes this finite source-order experiment and retained body/relocation/pool/EH checks, not general semantic equivalence, full-TU exactness, original-source provenance, or source-linked/runtime certification. Running variants on a later source context remeasures that context and does not reproduce the original negative source probes automatically.
name: r72-newcam-source-order-probe
purpose: Reproduce the bounded newcam definition-order experiment and verify the retained text, constant-pool, and exception-layout repair against an archived raw baseline.
